audience: small businesses and operators whose website gets attention but underperforms commercially

creative.subhook: Find the leak before you buy more traffic.
creative.visualMetaphor: A bright stream of visitor signals enters a browser-shaped system. Some energy reaches the conversion target while visible leaks escape through friction points. The site is the pipe, not the hero text.
guardrails: Do not imply that a particular customer's website has a known defect before the audit.
Keep typography subordinate to the central visual metaphor.
No fake audit result, fake health score, or fabricated customer metric.
The $49 offer and top-five-fixes deliverable must remain exact.

shots.intent: Open on the strongest visual fact: a flood of visitor signals enters a browser while conversion energy visibly escapes through a leak. The image must work before the words appear.
A clean scan passes through the browser and briefly illuminates five audit dimensions without pretending to show actual findings: clarity, speed, trust, mobile, CTA.
The chaos resolves into five crisp prioritized fix markers, communicating that the buyer gets a short actionable list rather than a giant report.
End on the clean product lockup. Keep movement alive but calm. Price and CTA must be instantly readable.
